item.title: M. John Harrison makes history as first sci-fi author to win the Booker Prize

item.title: Pedro Almodóvar explores how good friends can get so angry in 'Bitter Christmas'
item.description: In this film-within-a-film, Almodóvar explores how the closest pals can suddenly become bitterly estranged — and all the ways that art imitates life (and vice versa).

item.title: Hop in: We're taking a pop culture road trip on Route 66
item.description: Route 66 is celebrating 100 years of being the country's most famous highway. This icon of American culture passes through eight states — and has shown up for decades in movies, books, music and art.
